checks.reason: Explains enqueueing in ConcurrentLinkedQueue, REQUIRED publication and a drain attempt by the same caller, explicitly excluding a background worker. The quote shows the Runnable scheduling handoff (136–140, 454–462).

It explicitly identifies zero-capacity non-storage, sequential insertion/eviction, removal and clear followed by reuse as existing test corroboration, not proof of stronger concurrency properties (160–220; tests 34–109).

Observed item types are command_execution and agent_message only. Full event bytes were hashed while turn.completed usage was omitted from displayed review material; result.json and usage totals were not inspected. All six final quotes independently match exact decoded contiguous source ranges of 15–27 physical lines, and implementation/test/assertion-helper hashes match the frozen source review.
